responsibility: This source file implements the NDS32 builtin/intrinsic frontend-to-RTL bridge. It registers target builtin functions and expands calls to them by validating constant operands, converting scalar and vector arguments into legal RTL forms, choosing instruction codes, emitting target-specific patterns, and reporting diagnostics for invalid builtin usage, thereby connecting the public intrinsic header API to the backend’s md patterns and unspec operations.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/config/nds32/nds32-intrinsic.md, this C++ file is the procedural builtin side: it registers NDS32 intrinsics, checks immediate arguments, normalizes operands into RTL, and chooses/emits the matching md insn codes for intrinsic calls.
